I have no issues with broadcasting live. A few people will use it to spread messages of terror, or to become famous with hideous acts. And there will be some serious privacy breaches from it. But there will be far more cases where it's used to put the spotlight on abuses of power by police and other officials, to make movies of crimes while they are still happening, so that others can alert the police (which, as it requires audio, is not always possible for the witness), where retards broadcast themselves committing crimes, and so on. So all in all, it's going to make things safer for everyone.

I also see it as a way to balance power - the government has cameras pretty much everywhere but can choose what it publishes. With people also having cameras and fast publishing, important stuff will be very difficult to suppress.
